items: Your Google profile picture shows beside your account when Drive sync is on.
Maps, the SQL console and the AI coach no longer load code from other websites.
Erase everything on this device now removes all of Run315's data and only Run315's, disconnects Drive, and leaves your Drive copy untouched.
Days are always your local day: a late-evening run no longer shows up as tomorrow in charts, the coach's week or air quality.
Atkinson Hyperlegible is the default font, and you can pick another one in Sync & cowork.
Fixed a blank page that could appear right after an update.
Drive sync no longer tries to open a blocked sign-in popup in the background: press Sync now to reconnect when it asks.
Errors are recorded on this device and shown under Sync & cowork, ready to copy into a bug report.
The cowork folder gets a recent.json with your last six weeks, so daily and weekly briefs read fast and can tell when the data is stale.
If the browser forgets the cowork folder after a restart, a button asks for access again instead of exports stopping quietly.
Records and collections, a year in review, shareable images with privacy zones, and air quality on each run.
Replay a run, race your own ghost, and watch your coverage grow in a time-lapse.
Plan a run through streets and tiles you have never covered, and export it as GPX.
W′ balance through a run, and DFA-a1 when your watch records beat-to-beat intervals.
